interface.title: Earth Intelligence Platform
interface.field: Earth observation / geospatial environmental analysis (remote sensing, terrain, climate, land cover, hazard risk)
interface.stage_of_work: Data acquisition and exploratory analysis for one study area, leading to a composite hazard assessment
interface.what_it_is_for: Enter a city to define an area of interest, then run engines in sequence that pull public satellite, DEM, weather and land-cover data for it, ending in a multi-hazard risk assessment and one combined environmental intelligence score.

data.note: No files were uploaded. The AOI came from the built-in city lookup (Mumbai/India, 951.76 km², EPSG:4326). The engines fetched live public data: Copernicus DEM, Open-Meteo hourly weather for 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-30, ESA WorldCover. The Sentinel-2 search was set to start 2026-10-01 with at most 10% cloud. A pre-check reported matching imagery, but the run never finished.

tree.general: Characterise the environment of a chosen place from several public Earth-observation sources
tree.specific: Pick a city, resolve its AOI, set up the Satellite Engine search (the download never finished), then run the Terrain, Weather and Land Cover engines. Risk and Earth Intelligence stayed locked because Satellite output was missing.
